text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp starts today! As for<n>Shinko Windy...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you'll never guess what! I'm<n>trending on
Umatter!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone must finally be starting to<n>appreciate my
power! Lemme see<n>what they're saying...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I check my phone, too. But...

text_block_list.name: Umatter
text_block_list.text:
News: The "Shishimai Festival" is a<n>big draw! Kids
laugh as their heads<n>are "bitten" by the lion to ward
off bad<n>luck.

text_block_list.name: Umatter
text_block_list.text:
—Was it Windy? —Sure reminds me of<n>Shinko
Windy. —Ohhh, I really hope<n>she was the lion!

text_block_list.name: Umatter
text_block_list.text:
—All I see now is Windy. Her chomp<n>face is so cute!
#ShishimaiFestival<n>#ShinkoWindy

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I had nothing to do with that, though...<n>Wait, are they
all making fun of me?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
GRRR... This ain't it! They're<n>supposed to be calling
me stuff like<n>"strong" and "terrifying!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's been memeified<n>as the "lion
chomper."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's only got herself to blame for<n>the reputation
she's gained. And<n>there's only one thing she can
do to<n>change the course of this current<n>narrative.
choice_data_list: Let's focus on summer camp for now.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah... That's all I can do for now.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But just you wait—next time I race,<n>I'm gonna shut
'em all up with my<n>sheer power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We board the bus, and Shinko Windy<n>walks to her
assigned seat...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, you! Lemme have the window<n>seat!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Biko?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...O-oh? Sorry, I spaced out for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up? Got a<n>stomachache?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No... I was just doing some thinking<n>about my last
race...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've lost so many times in a row<n>now... But last
time, I actually made it<n>onto the scoreboard, which
means I<n>was almost there...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm just trying to figure out why I<n>wasn't able to
push harder during the<n>final straight.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ugh... This isn't heroic of me at all...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But I've got to turn the page. This<n>summer, I'll
become a brand-new<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Because heroes never give up!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All right! First run, here I come...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
This isn't the time to be dragging my<n>feet... I have
to train!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, Biko! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Eat this! Hi-yaaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: PSHOOO! PSHOOO-SHOOO-SHOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! Now you're soaked!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, little miss savior<n>of justice?
Can't even dodge a lil'<n>squirt gun?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nana-nana, boo-hoo! Catch me if ya<n>can!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Stop right there!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Rgh! In the name of justice, I will stopyou! Ready? Pegasus Mach Stri—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heh! ...Ahaha! It's been a long time<n>since we've
done this.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wait a second... Windy... Are you...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trying to make me feel better?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Geez... Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I knew you weren't the villain people<n>make you out
to be...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You're not a cowardly thug—far from<n>it...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! C'mon, slowpoke! You gonna<n>chase me or
what?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy! Rather than play tag, would<n>you be willing to
train with me?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, you're running in<n>a race while
we're at camp, right?<n>And a G1 at that.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Who cares?! Training can wait! Later!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hey! No playing hooky! Stop right<n>there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Japan Dirt Derby coming up<n>during camp,
a hot summer of training<n>and racing is about to
begin!
